```yaml
document_metadata:
  document_id: unicommerce_wms_canonical_curated_v17_edge_coverage
  source_docx: Unicommerce Recon KB.docx
  prior_working_markdown: unicommerce_operations.md
  blueprint: Canonical Card Pack Blueprint v1.9
  validator: verify_canonical_cards.py v17 edge coverage
  broadcast_domain: wms
  system: Unicommerce
  system_role: wms_warehouse_fulfilment_and_shipment_tracking_layer
  content_preservation_policy: DOCX content is preserved in the source-capture appendix. Canonical cards broadcast Unicommerce as WMS and retain
    invoice, shipment, tax, channel, courier, SKU, return, cancellation and safe-join facts needed for WMS planning.
  runtime_scope_policy: No tenant, group, platform-account, account-binding, business-scope or business-flow cards are emitted in this reusable
    semantic pack.
```

## Issue register and curation notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: v17.locked_validation
  status: resolved
  resolution: Pack is rewritten for v1.9/v17 edge coverage, canonical node lineage, role-specific semantic profiles, scoped edges, SQL blueprint
    depth and non-filler embedding text.
```

## Scope stance

Unicommerce is broadcast here as a **WMS / warehouse fulfilment system**. The source also documents OMS, invoice, GST, channel, courier and commercial facts; those are retained only where they explain warehouse dispatch, shipment tracking, returns, cancellations, SKU movement and safe joins. Runtime/client cards remain out of scope.

      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: grouped_aggregate

        \ = :group_level_id\n  AND shipping_method IS NOT NULL\nGROUP BY shipping_method\nORDER BY shipments DESC\nLIMIT 20"

        required: true

      - stage: base_filter
        expression: shipping_method IS NOT NULL
        filter_type: business_filter
        required: true
        source: query_pattern
        purpose: Required for safe Unicommerce WMS SQL handoff.
      join_plan: []

    output_contract_id: output_contract.wms.unicommerce.full_enriched_order_view

    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: record_level_join
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: group_level_id
        required: true
        type: integer
        source: runtime_account_binding
        description: Injected from client runtime account binding, never hardcoded in reusable WMS cards.
      required_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.unicommerce
      - table.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
      required_columns:
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.invoice_number
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.sku_id
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.metadata
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.is_active
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce.group_level_id
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_status
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report.other_id
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report.shipping_method
      - column.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report.is_active
      template: "SELECT\n  u.order_id,\n  u.invoice_number,\n  u.created_date,\n  u.sku_id,\n  u.description,\n  u.quantity,\n  u.metadata AS\
        \ transaction_class,\n  u.transaction_type AS transaction_subtype,\n  u.sales_channel,\n  u.source_gst_name,\n  o.order_status,\n  o.other_id\
        \ AS awb,\n  o.shipping_method,\n  o.mrp AS catalogue_mrp\nFROM zs_observe.unicommerce u\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report\
        \ o\n  ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id\n AND o.is_active = true\nWHERE u.is_active = true\n  AND u.metadata = 'sales'\n  AND u.group_level_id\
        \ = :group_level_id"
      ctes: []
      joins:
      - relationship_id: relationship.zs_observe.unicommerce.to_order_sales_report.order_id_hash_prefix
        join_type: left
        left_table: table.zs_observe.unicommerce
        right_table: table.zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
        join_condition: '''#'' || u.order_id = o.order_id'
        pre_aggregation_required: false
        safety_note: Never use direct unprefixed order join.
      filters:
      - expression: u.is_active = true
        filter_type: mandatory_quality_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      - expression: u.metadata = 'sales'
        filter_type: business_filter
        source: query_pattern
        required: true
      - expression: u.group_level_id = :group_level_id
        filter_type: runtime_scope_filter

## Source capture appendix — DOCX text preserved

<details><summary>All extracted DOCX lines</summary>

~~~text
0001: Tab 1
0002: # Unicommerce — Business Knowledge Base
0003: 
0004: ---
0005: 
0006: ## 1. What Is Unicommerce?
0007: 
0008: **Unicommerce is an Order Management System (OMS), not a marketplace.** It is India's leading cloud-based OMS/WMS platform used by e-commerce sellers to manage their multi-channel operations from a single system. Unicommerce aggregates orders from all marketplaces and D2C channels, manages fulfilment across multiple warehouses, generates GST-compliant invoices, and tracks every order from placement to delivery or return.
0009: 
0010: **Unicommerce integrates with:**
0011: 
0012: * Marketplace channels (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Snapdeal)
0013: * D2C storefronts (Shopify, custom portals)
0014: * Quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Instamart/Swiggy)
0015: * Courier partners (Delhivery, Shadowfax, XpressBees, BlueDart, Ekart)
0016: * Accounting systems (Tally ERP)
0017: 
0018: **In ZenStatement's pipeline, Unicommerce represents the operations/invoice layer** — distinct from individual marketplace settlement tables which represent the financial/payout layer.
0019: 
0020: 
0021: ---
0022: 
0023: ## 2. Table Overview — Two-Table Structure
0024: 
0025: The Unicommerce pipeline in ZenStatement uses two complementary tables:
0026: 
0027: | Table | Purpose | Rows |
0028: |-------|---------|------|
0029: | `zs_observe.unicommerce` | **Financial / Invoice view** — Sales, Returns, and Cancellations with GST invoice data, charged amounts, discounts, taxes | 3,253,598 |
0030: | `zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report` | **Logistics / Shipment view** — Delivery status, AWB tracking number, shipping method, MRP | 3,017,728 |
0031: 
0032: ### The Critical Join
0033: 
0034: The two tables share the same order numbers but with a **format difference**:
0035: 
0036: ```
0037: unicommerce.order_id              = 9204353418661
0038: unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id = #9204353418661
0039: ```
0040: 
0041: **Correct join:**
0042: 
0043: ```sql
0044: ON '#' || unicommerce.order_id = unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id
0045: ```
0046: 
0047: A direct join (without `#` prefix) returns only 4.9% coverage. The `#`-prefixed join returns **91.1% coverage (1,337,542 orders matched)**.
0048: 
0049: ## 3. Transaction Types in `unicommerce`
0050: 
0051: The `metadata` field is the **single source of truth** for transaction classification. All three transaction types are stored in one table:
0052: 
0053: | `metadata` | `transaction_type` | Count | Meaning |
0054: |----------|------------------|-------|---------|
0055: | `sales`  | `PREPAID`        | 2,122,372 | Forward order — customer paid online |
0056: | `sales`  | `COD`            | 860,450 | Forward order — cash on delivery |
0057: | `reverse` | `Courier Return` | 233,379 | Return-to-Origin (RTO) — delivery failed |
0058: | `reverse` | `Customer Return` | 28,285 | Buyer-initiated return after delivery |
0059: | `cancel` | `COD` / `PREPAID` | 9,112 | Order cancelled before dispatch |
0060: 
0061: **No separate returns or cancellations tables exist for Unicommerce** — unlike every other marketplace pipeline in ZenStatement.
0062: 
0063: 
0064: ---
0065: 
0066: ## 4. Key Business Metrics (April–December 2025)
0067: 
0068: | Metric | Value |
0069: |--------|-------|
0070: | Total orders (sales) | \~1.47M distinct orders |
0071: | Total Sales GMV | ₹139.4 Cr |
0072: | Total Returns value | ₹15.1 Cr |
0073: | Total Cancels value | ₹8.1 Cr |
0074: | Average selling price (Prepaid) | ₹408  |
0075: | Average selling price (COD) | ₹614  |
0076: | Overall AOV | \~₹477 (blended) |
0077: | Average MRP | ₹1,625 (from OSR) |
0078: | Average discount off MRP | \~70% |
0079: | RTO rate | \~18.0% (233K RTOs / 1.29M sales orders) |
0080: | Customer Return rate | \~1.9% (28K returns / 1.47M sales) |
0081: | Delivery rate | \~84.8% (DELIVERED / total dispatched) |
0082: | COD share | \~28.8% |
0083: 
0084: 
0085: ---
0086: 
0087: ## 5. Sales Channel Architecture
0088: 
0089: Astrotalk sells across 18 channels managed through Unicommerce:
0090: 
0091: | Channel | Type | Volume (rows) | GMV | Notes |
0092: |---------|------|---------------|-----|-------|
0093: | `Astrotalk_Store` | D2C app/website | 3,037,601     | ₹117.6 Cr | Primary — 93% of all rows |

0191: ## 9. Full Transaction Lifecycle
0192: 
0193: ### 9.1 Forward Sale
0194: 
0195: ```
0196: Customer orders via Astrotalk app / website / marketplace
0197:         ↓
0198: Unicommerce OMS receives order from channel
0199:         ↓
0200: GST invoice generated by warehouse's GSTIN
0201: unicommerce:
0202:   metadata = 'sales'
0203:   transaction_type = 'COD' or 'PREPAID'
0204:   invoice_number = 'INSEG-25-26-XXXXX'  (sales invoice)
0205:         ↓
0206: Warehouse: Pick → Pack → Manifest → Dispatch
0207: unicommerce_order_sales_report:
0208:   order_status = 'MANIFESTED' → 'DISPATCHED'
0209:   other_id = AWB tracking number
0210:   shipping_method = courier + service level
0211:         ↓
0212: Delivered to buyer
0213: unicommerce_order_sales_report:
0214:   order_status = 'DELIVERED'
0215: ```
0216: 
0217: ### 9.2 Return-to-Origin (RTO / Courier Return)
0218: 
0219: ```
0220: Courier attempts delivery — fails
0221: (buyer absent / wrong address / refused)
0222:         ↓
0223: Courier triggers Return-to-Origin
0224: unicommerce:
0225:   metadata = 'reverse'
0226:   transaction_type = 'Courier Return'
0227:   invoice_number = 'SRFZ-XXXXX'  (SR = Stock Return credit note)
0228:         ↓
0229: Item returned to Astrotalk warehouse
0230: unicommerce_order_sales_report:
0231:   order_status = 'RESHIPPED' (if re-dispatched)
0232:   or 'CANCELLED' (if abandoned)
0233: ```
0234: 
0235: ### 9.3 Customer Return
0236: 
0237: ```
0238: Buyer receives item but initiates return
0239:         ↓
0240: Unicommerce creates reverse entry
0241: unicommerce:
0242:   metadata = 'reverse'
0243:   transaction_type = 'Customer Return'
0244:   charged_amount = original sale value
0245:         ↓
0246: Item returned; refund processed
0247: ```
0248: 
0249: ### 9.4 Cancellation
0250: 
0251: ```
0252: Order placed but cancelled before dispatch
0253:         ↓
0254: unicommerce:
0255:   metadata = 'cancel'
0256:   transaction_type = 'COD' or 'PREPAID'
0257:   invoice_number = cancellation invoice
0258:         ↓
0259: unicommerce_order_sales_report:
0260:   order_status = 'CANCELLED'
0261: ```
0262: 
0263:

0265: 
0266: ## 10. GST / Tax Framework
0267: 
0268: ### 10.1 GST Application
0269: 
0270: All Astrotalk products attract GST at 3%–12% depending on product type:
0271: 
0272: | Scenario | GST Type | When |
0273: |----------|----------|------|
0274: | Source state ≠ Destination state | IGST (3%, 5%, or 12%) | Inter-state shipment |
0275: | Source state = Destination state | CGST + SGST (split equally) | Intra-state shipment |
0276: 
0277: The majority of orders are **inter-state** (given pan-India shipping from 4 warehouse hubs), with IGST applied at 3% for jewellery/crystal products (HSN 7117xxxx).
0278: 
0279: ### 10.2 TCS (Tax Collected at Source)
0280: 
0281: `total_tcs_amount = 0` for all rows in `unicommerce`. Astrotalk operates as a **brand/seller** (not as an e-commerce operator), so the TCS obligation under §52 CGST Act rests with the marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra) for those channel orders. For `Astrotalk_Store` (D2C), Astrotalk itself is the e-commerce operator and handles TCS separately — it is not reflected in this Unicommerce pipeline.
0282: 
0283: ### 10.3 Invoice Number Conventions
0284: 
0285: | Prefix | Table | Meaning |
0286: |--------|-------|---------|
0287: | `INSEG-25-26-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Sales invoice — Emiza Gurugram |
0288: | `INSFZP-25-26-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Sales invoice — FZP warehouse |
0289: | `MHR-25-26-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Sales invoice — Haryana |
0290: | `MWB-25-26-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Sales invoice — West Bengal |
0291: | `SRFZ-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Stock Return / Credit note — FZP |
0292: | `SRMM-XXXXX` | unicommerce | Stock Return — Mumbai |

0297: ## 11. Reconciliation Use Cases
0298: 
0299: ### 11.1 Sales vs Returns vs Cancels — Net Revenue
0300: 
0301: ```sql
0302: SELECT
0303:   SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_gmv,
0304:   SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS return_value,
0305:   SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='cancel' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_value,
0306:   SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)
0307:     - SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)
0308:     - SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='cancel' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue
0309: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0310: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211;
0311: ```
0312: 
0313: ### 11.2 Full Enriched View (Sales + AWB + Delivery Status)
0314: 
0315: ```sql
0316: SELECT
0317:   u.order_id, u.invoice_number, u.created_date,
0318:   u.sku_id, u.description, u.quantity,
0319:   u.metadata AS txn_type, u.transaction_type AS payment_type,
0320:   u.charged_amount, u.discount,
0321:   u.tax_igst_rate, u.tax_igst_amount,
0322:   u.sales_channel, u.source_gst_name,
0323:   u.destination_state, u.destination_city,
0324:   o.order_status, o.other_id AS awb,
0325:   o.shipping_method, o.mrp AS catalogue_mrp
0326: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce u
0327: LEFT JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report o
0328:   ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true
0329: WHERE u.is_active = true
0330:   AND u.metadata = 'sales'
0331:   AND u.group_level_id = 211;
0332: ```
0333: 
0334: ### 11.3 Return Rate Analysis
0335: 
0336: ```sql
0337: SELECT
0338:   sales_channel,
0339:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN order_id END) AS sold,
0340:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Courier Return'
0341:     THEN order_id END) AS rto,
0342:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Customer Return'
0343:     THEN order_id END) AS cust_return,
0344:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='cancel' THEN order_id END) AS cancelled,
0345:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type='Courier Return'
0346:     THEN order_id END)
0347:     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales'
0348:     THEN order_id END), 0), 2) AS rto_rate_pct
0349: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0350: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211
0351: GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY sold DESC;
0352: ```
0353: 
0354: ### 11.4 Delivery Rate by Courier
0355: 
0356: ```sql
0357: SELECT shipping_method,
0358:   COUNT(*) AS total,
0359:   COUNT_IF(order_status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered,
0360:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(order_status = 'DELIVERED')
0361:     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS delivery_rate_pct
0362: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
0363: WHERE is_active = true AND shipping_method IS NOT NULL
0364: GROUP BY shipping_method ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 15;
0365: ```
0366: 
0367: ### 11.5 GST Summary
0368: 
0369: ```sql
0370: SELECT
0371:   CASE WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Interstate (IGST)'
0372:        ELSE 'Intrastate (CGST+SGST)' END AS gst_type,
0373:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
0374:   SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
0375:   SUM(tax_igst_amount) AS igst,
0376:   SUM(tax_cgst_amount + tax_sgst_amount) AS cgst_sgst_total
0377: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0378: WHERE is_active = true AND metadata = 'sales' AND group_level_id = 211
0379: GROUP BY 1;
0380: ```

0385: ## 12. Data Quality Observations & Known Issues
0386: 
0387: | Issue | Detail | Mitigation |
0388: |-------|--------|------------|
0389: | `**order_id #**` **prefix mismatch** | `unicommerce.order_id` has no `#`; OSR has `#` prefix | Always join: `'#' \|\| unicommerce.order_id = osr.order_id` |
0390: | **AWB only in OSR, not** `**unicommerce**` | `unicommerce.awb_num` = NULL for all rows | Use `unicommerce_order_sales_report.other_id` for tracking |
0391: | **All 3 transaction types in one table** | Sales, returns, and cancels share the same table | Always filter on `metadata` field first |
0392: | **Freebie SKUs at ₹1** | `RD_0325_05` (Rudraksha) ships at ₹1 bundled with paid items | Filter `charged_amount > 1` to exclude freebies from revenue |
0393: | `total_tcs_amount = 0` | Astrotalk is not TCS-obligated as a seller (not operator) | No TCS reconciliation needed for this table |
0394: | `hsn` NULL for \~306K rows | Some products lack HSN mapping | Use `hsn_generated` or `product_hsn_code` as fallback |
0395: | `brand` mostly NULL | Brand carried in `sales_channel` and `source_gst_name` | Group by `source_gst_name` or `sales_channel` |
0396: | Multiple rows per order | Multi-item orders = one row per SKU per order | Use `COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)` for orders; `SUM(charged_amount)` for value |
0397: | `group_level_id = 22` (9,433 rows) | PrettyKrafts / Mensa — very small, Oct 2025 only | Filter `group_level_id = 211` for Astrotalk analysis |
0398: | OSR join coverage 91.1% | \~8.9% of orders have no OSR match | Returns and cancels typically lack OSR shipment records |

0434: Tab 2
0435: # Table: Unicommerce Order Sales Report — Table Knowledge Base
0436: 
0437: **Schema:** `zs_observe`  **Table:** `unicommerce_order_sales_report`  **Last Updated:** April 2025  **Maintained By:** ZenStatement Data Team
0438: 
0439: 
0440: ---
0441: 
0442: ## 1. Table Overview
0443: 
0444: `unicommerce_order_sales_report` (OSR) is the **shipment-level fulfilment and delivery tracking table** for the Unicommerce pipeline. It is the **logistics complement** to the `unicommerce` table — while `unicommerce` holds the financial/invoice view (charges, taxes, discounts), the OSR holds the operational/dispatch view: delivery status, AWB number, shipping method, MRP, and package dimensions.
0445: 
0446: **Key role in the pipeline:**
0447: 
0448: * `unicommerce` → What was invoiced (GMV, GST, SKU, payment type)
0449: * `unicommerce_order_sales_report` → What was shipped (AWB, courier, delivery status, MRP)
0450: 
0451: Both tables cover the same orders and SKUs, joined via the `order_id` key — but **with a critical prefix difference:** `unicommerce.order_id` is stored without `#`, while OSR's `order_id` is stored with `#`. The correct join is `'#' || unicommerce.order_id = unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id`.
0452: 
0453: **Client:** Astrotalk (group_level_id = 211)\n**Currency:** INR
0454:

0621: ## 6. Data Quality Observations
0622: 
0623: | Issue | Detail | Mitigation |
0624: |-------|--------|------------|
0625: | `order_id` has `#` prefix | Different from `unicommerce` table | Join: `'#' \|\| unicommerce.order_id = osr.order_id` |
0626: | Many columns NULL | `channel_name`, `category`, `facility`, `sale_order_status`, `billing_address_*`, `total_price`, `discount`, `sku_name` are largely unpopulated | Use `order_status`, `shipping_method`, `other_id`, `mrp` as primary operational fields |
0627: | `DISPATCHED` orders may be post-cutoff deliveries | 256,799 rows in DISPATCHED status at data capture time | Treat as in-transit; final status not yet recorded |
0628: | `RESHIPPED` vs `REPLACED` | RESHIPPED = same item resent (courier failed); REPLACED = different item sent | Track separately for operations quality |
0629: | `other_id` sometimes contains method name | A few rows have courier method name instead of AWB | Filter: `LENGTH(other_id) > 10` for valid AWB |

0634: ## 7. Common Query Patterns
0635: 
0636: ### 7.1 Delivery Rate Analysis
0637: 
0638: ```sql
0639: SELECT order_status,
0640:   COUNT(*) AS rows,
0641:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
0642:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
0643: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
0644: WHERE is_active = true
0645: GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY rows DESC;
0646: ```
0647: 
0648: ### 7.2 Courier Performance
0649: 
0650: ```sql
0651: SELECT shipping_method,
0652:   COUNT(*) AS shipments,
0653:   COUNT_IF(order_status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered,
0654:   COUNT_IF(order_status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled,
0655:   COUNT_IF(order_status = 'RESHIPPED') AS reshipped,
0656:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(order_status = 'DELIVERED')
0657:     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS delivery_rate_pct
0658: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
0659: WHERE is_active = true AND shipping_method IS NOT NULL
0660: GROUP BY shipping_method ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 20;
0661: ```
0662: 
0663: ### 7.3 Full Enriched View (Join Sales + OSR)
0664: 
0665: ```sql
0666: SELECT
0667:   u.order_id, u.invoice_number,
0668:   u.sku_id, u.description, u.mrp AS invoice_mrp,
0669:   u.charged_amount, u.discount,
0670:   u.metadata, u.transaction_type, u.sales_channel,
0671:   u.source_gst_name, u.destination_state, u.destination_city,
0672:   o.order_status, o.other_id AS awb,
0673:   o.shipping_method, o.mrp AS catalogue_mrp,
0674:   o.created_date AS dispatch_date
0675: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce u
0676: LEFT JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report o
0677:   ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true
0678: WHERE u.is_active = true
0679:   AND u.metadata = 'sales'
0680:   AND u.group_level_id = 211;
0681: ```
0682: 
0683: ### 7.4 MRP vs Selling Price Analysis
0684: 
0685: ```sql
0686: SELECT
0687:   u.sku_id, u.description,
0688:   AVG(o.mrp) AS avg_mrp,
0689:   AVG(u.charged_amount) AS avg_selling_price,
0690:   ROUND(100.0 * (1 - AVG(u.charged_amount) / NULLIF(AVG(o.mrp), 0)), 1) AS avg_discount_pct
0691: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce u
0692: JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report o
0693:   ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true
0694: WHERE u.is_active = true AND u.metadata = 'sales'
0695: GROUP BY u.sku_id, u.description
0696: ORDER BY avg_mrp DESC LIMIT 20;
0697: ```
0698:

0704: 
0705: # Unicommerce — Business Knowledge Base
0706: 
0707: **System:** Unicommerce OMS (Order Management System)\n**Client:** Astrotalk (primary) + PrettyKrafts/Mensa (minor)\n**group_level_id:** 211 (Astrotalk), 22 (PrettyKrafts)\n**Last Updated:** April 2025\n**Maintained By:** ZenStatement Data Team
0708: 
0709: 
0710: ---
0711: 
0712: ## 1. What Is Unicommerce?
0713: 
0714: **Unicommerce is an Order Management System (OMS), not a marketplace.** It is a cloud-based platform that aggregates orders from all of Astrotalk's marketplaces and D2C channels, manages warehouse operations across multiple fulfilment centres, generates GST invoices, and tracks the complete order lifecycle.
0715: 
0716: Unicommerce integrates with marketplace channels (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra), D2C stores (Shopify, custom portals), quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Instamart), courier partners (Delhivery, Shadowfax, XpressBees, BlueDart), and accounting systems (Tally) — providing a unified operational view.
0717: 
0718: **In ZenStatement's pipeline:**
0719: 
0720: * `unicommerce` → Financial/invoice view (OMS layer) — contains Sales + Returns + Cancellations
0721: * `unicommerce_order_sales_report` → Logistics/shipment view — contains delivery status + AWB + MRP
0722: 
0723: 
0724: ---
0725: 
0726: ## 2. Who Is the Client? — Astrotalk
0727: 
0728: Astrotalk is India's leading astrology and spiritual wellness platform, offering products including:
0729: 
0730: | Category | Products | Key SKUs |
0731: |----------|----------|----------|
0732: | Bracelets | Pyrite, crystal, rudraksha, evil eye bracelets | `BP_0068` (Dhan Yog Bracelet), `BP_0074`, `BP_0360` |
0733: | Anklets  | Pyrite, crystal anklets | `WJ_0001` (Pyrite Anklet) |
0734: | Plates   | Selenite plates, crystal slabs | `SEL_0004`, `SEL_0001` |
0735: | Décor / Feng Shui | Pyrite horses, yantra frames | `F_0012`, `F_1007` |
0736: | Rudraksha | Rudraksha beads (freebie bundles) | `RD_0325_05` (₹1 freebie) |
0737: | Cards    | Siddhi cards, spiritual cards | `CF_0005_GC` |
0738: | Metal jewellery | Metal bangles, gold-plated items | `BP_0402` |
0739: 
0740: **Business model:** Customers buy spiritual/astrological products from Astrotalk's app or website. Physical products are shipped from Astrotalk's fulfilment network. The core business is COD + Prepaid, with a large freebie bundling strategy (Rudraksha freebie shipped at ₹1 alongside paid items).
0741: 
0742: 
0743: ---
0744: 
0745: ## 3. The Two-Table Relationship
0746: 
0747: ```
0748:          unicommerce                    unicommerce_order_sales_report
0749:          ───────────                    ──────────────────────────────
0750:          (Financial / Invoice View)     (Logistics / Shipment View)
0751: 
0752:          order_id: 9204353418661  ←───→  order_id: #9204353418661
0753:                 (WITHOUT #)                        (WITH # prefix)
0754: 
0755:          sku_id, invoice_number          sku_id, description, mrp
0756:          charged_amount, discount        order_status, shipping_method
0757:          tax_igst_amount, tcs            other_id (AWB tracking number)
0758:          metadata (sales/reverse/cancel) gross_weight, dimensions
0759:          source_gst_name (warehouse)     delivery status
0760:          sales_channel                   courier method
0761: ```
0762: 
0763: **Join Key:**
0764: 
0765: ```sql
0766: ON '#' || unicommerce.order_id = unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id
0767: ```
0768: 
0769: **Coverage:** 1,337,542 matched orders out of 1,468,885 unicommerce orders = **91.1%**
0770: 
0771: **Why the gap (8.9%):**
0772: 
0773: * Returns and cancellations in `unicommerce` may not have OSR shipment records
0774: * Some older orders may have incomplete OSR records
0775: * The OSR has 3,017,728 rows vs unicommerce's 3,253,598 — OSR may represent shipped items only
0776: 
0777:

0812: 
0813: ## 5. Transaction Lifecycle
0814: 
0815: ### 5.1 Forward Sale Flow
0816: 
0817: ```
0818: Customer orders via Astrotalk app / website / marketplace
0819:         ↓
0820: Order ingested into Unicommerce OMS
0821:         ↓
0822: GST invoice generated by warehouse's GSTIN
0823:         ↓
0824: unicommerce: metadata='sales'
0825:   transaction_type = 'COD' or 'PREPAID'
0826:   invoice_number = 'INSEG-25-26-XXXXX'
0827:         ↓
0828: Item picked, packed, manifested at warehouse
0829:         ↓
0830: unicommerce_order_sales_report: order_status = 'MANIFESTED' → 'DISPATCHED'
0831:   other_id = AWB tracking number
0832:   shipping_method = courier + service
0833:         ↓
0834: Delivered to buyer
0835:         ↓
0836: unicommerce_order_sales_report: order_status = 'DELIVERED'
0837: ```
0838: 
0839: ### 5.2 Return Flow (Courier Return = RTO)
0840: 
0841: ```
0842: Courier fails to deliver (buyer absent / refused / wrong address)
0843:         ↓
0844: Courier triggers Return-to-Origin (RTO)
0845:         ↓
0846: unicommerce: metadata='reverse', transaction_type='Courier Return'
0847:   invoice_number = 'SRFZ-XXXXX' (SR prefix = Stock Return)
0848:   charged_amount = original sale value
0849:         ↓
0850: unicommerce_order_sales_report: order_status = 'RESHIPPED' (if re-dispatched)
0851:   or order_status = 'CANCELLED' (if not re-dispatched)
0852: ```
0853: 
0854: ### 5.3 Return Flow (Customer Return)
0855: 
0856: ```
0857: Buyer initiates return after receiving order
0858:         ↓
0859: unicommerce: metadata='reverse', transaction_type='Customer Return'
0860:   invoice_number = credit note number
0861:         ↓
0862: Refund processed; item returned to warehouse
0863: ```
0864: 
0865: ### 5.4 Cancellation Flow
0866: 
0867: ```
0868: Order cancelled before dispatch
0869:         ↓
0870: unicommerce: metadata='cancel'
0871:   transaction_type = 'COD' or 'PREPAID'
0872:   invoice_number = cancellation invoice
0873:         ↓
0874: unicommerce_order_sales_report: order_status = 'CANCELLED'
0875: ```
0876: 
0877: 
0878: ---
0879: 
0880: ## 6. Entity Relationships
0881: 
0882: ### 6.1 Primary Join
0883: 
0884: | Relationship | Left Table | Right Table | Join Key | Coverage |
0885: |--------------|------------|-------------|----------|----------|
0886: | Financial ↔ Logistics | unicommerce | unicommerce_order_sales_report | `'#' \|\| u.order_id = o.order_id` | 91.1%    |
0887: | SKU cross-reference | unicommerce | unicommerce_order_sales_report | `u.sku_id = o.sku_id` | 1,130/1,871 = 60.4% |
0888: 
0889: ### 6.2 Unicommerce vs Marketplace Tables
0890: 
0891: The Unicommerce pipeline is **separate** from individual marketplace tables in ZenStatement. However, for Astrotalk orders placed on Amazon/Flipkart/Myntra, those marketplace's settlement tables may have separate records. The Unicommerce OMS represents the **seller's operational view** while marketplace tables represent the **marketplace's financial view**.
0892:

0895: 
0896: ## 7. Key Business Metrics (with SQL)
0897: 
0898: ### 7.1 Total GMV by Month and Channel
0899: 
0900: ```sql
0901: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month,
0902:   sales_channel,
0903:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
0904:   SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
0905:   AVG(charged_amount) AS aov
0906: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0907: WHERE is_active = true AND metadata = 'sales' AND group_level_id = 211
0908: GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC;
0909: ```
0910: 
0911: ### 7.2 Return Rate by Type
0912: 
0913: ```sql
0914: SELECT
0915:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN order_id END) AS sold_orders,
0916:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Courier Return' THEN order_id END) AS rto_orders,
0917:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Customer Return' THEN order_id END) AS cust_return_orders,
0918:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='cancel' THEN order_id END) AS cancelled_orders,
0919:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type='Courier Return' THEN order_id END)
0920:     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN order_id END), 0), 2) AS rto_rate_pct
0921: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0922: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211;
0923: ```
0924: 
0925: ### 7.3 Delivery Rate from OSR
0926: 
0927: ```sql
0928: SELECT
0929:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status='DELIVERED' THEN order_id END) AS delivered,
0930:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_shipped,
0931:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status='DELIVERED' THEN order_id END)
0932:     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS delivery_rate_pct
0933: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report
0934: WHERE is_active = true;
0935: ```
0936: 
0937: ### 7.4 Freebie Analysis (₹1 SKUs)
0938: 
0939: ```sql
0940: SELECT sku_id, description,
0941:   COUNT(*) AS cnt,
0942:   SUM(charged_amount) AS total_revenue,
0943:   AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_price,
0944:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS bundled_in_orders
0945: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0946: WHERE is_active = true AND metadata = 'sales'
0947:   AND charged_amount < 2
0948: GROUP BY sku_id, description ORDER BY cnt DESC;
0949: ```
0950: 
0951: ### 7.5 Full Enriched Order View
0952: 
0953: ```sql
0954: SELECT u.order_id, u.invoice_number, u.created_date,
0955:   u.sku_id, u.description, u.quantity,
0956:   u.metadata AS txn_type, u.transaction_type AS payment_type,
0957:   u.charged_amount, u.discount, u.tax_igst_amount,
0958:   u.sales_channel, u.source_gst_name,
0959:   u.destination_state, u.destination_city,
0960:   o.order_status, o.other_id AS awb, o.shipping_method,
0961:   o.mrp AS catalogue_mrp
0962: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce u
0963: LEFT JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report o
0964:   ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true
0965: WHERE u.is_active = true
0966:   AND u.metadata = 'sales'
0967:   AND u.group_level_id = 211
0968:   AND u.sales_channel = 'Astrotalk_Store'
0969: LIMIT 100;
0970: ```
0971: 
0972: ### 7.6 Warehouse Throughput
0973: 
0974: ```sql
0975: SELECT source_gst_id, source_gst_name,
0976:   COUNT_IF(metadata='sales') AS sales,
0977:   COUNT_IF(metadata='reverse') AS returns,
0978:   COUNT_IF(metadata='cancel') AS cancels,
0979:   SUM(CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv
0980: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
0981: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211
0982: GROUP BY source_gst_id, source_gst_name
0983: ORDER BY sales DESC;
0984: ```

0988: 
0989: ## 8. Data Quality Observations & Known Issues
0990: 
0991: | Issue | Tables | Detail | Mitigation |
0992: |-------|--------|--------|------------|
0993: | `order_id` prefix mismatch | Both   | `unicommerce` = no `#`; OSR = with `#` | Join: `'#' \|\| u.order_id = o.order_id` |
0994: | 91.1% join coverage | Both   | \~8.9% of orders don't match across tables | Returns/cancels may lack OSR records; expected |
0995: | `awb_num` NULL in `unicommerce` | unicommerce | AWB only in OSR | Use `unicommerce_order_sales_report.other_id` |
0996: | `total_tcs_amount = 0` | unicommerce | Astrotalk is not subject to TCS (not e-commerce operator) | No TCS reconciliation needed |
0997: | `brand` NULL mostly | unicommerce | Use `sales_channel` / `source_gst_name` as proxy |            |
0998: | `channel_name`, `category` NULL in OSR | OSR    | Raw Unicommerce fields not populated in export | Use `unicommerce.sales_channel` after join |
0999: | Freebie SKUs at ₹1 | unicommerce | `RD_0325_05` shipped at ₹1 — bundles with paid orders | Filter `charged_amount > 1` for revenue analysis; count separately |
1000: | `hsn` NULL for \~306K rows | unicommerce | Some products lack HSN | Use `hsn_generated` as fallback |
1001: | `group_level_id = 22` (9,433 rows) | unicommerce | PrettyKrafts/Mensa (Oct 2025, Gujarat WH) — tiny footprint | Always filter `group_level_id = 211` for Astrotalk analysis |

1035: # Table: Unicommerce — Table Knowledge Base

1037: **Schema:** `zs_observe`  **Table:** `unicommerce`  **Last Updated:** April 2025  **Maintained By:** ZenStatement Data Team

1040: ---
1041: 
1042: ## 1. Table Overview
1043: 
1044: `unicommerce` is the **unified order and transaction ledger** managed through the Unicommerce OMS (Order Management System). Unlike individual marketplace tables, this single table contains **all three transaction types** — Sales, Returns, and Cancellations — differentiated by the `metadata` field.
1045: 
1046: **What Unicommerce is:** Unicommerce is India's leading cloud-based OMS platform for e-commerce sellers. It aggregates orders from all marketplaces and D2C channels, manages warehouse operations, generates invoices, and tracks the full order lifecycle from placement to delivery or return.
1047: 
1048: **The** `**metadata**` **field is the primary transaction classifier:**
1049: 
1050: * `metadata = 'sales'` → Forward sales (invoiced orders)
1051: * `metadata = 'reverse'` → Returns (Courier Return = RTO + Customer Return)
1052: * `metadata = 'cancel'` → Cancellations
1053:

1311: ## 6. Data Quality Observations
1312: 
1313: | Issue | Detail | Mitigation |
1314: |-------|--------|------------|
1315: | `**order_id**` **missing** `**#**` **prefix** | `unicommerce.order_id = '9204353418661'` vs `unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id = '#9204353418661'` | Join via `'#' \|\| u.order_id = o.order_id` |
1316: | `hsn` NULL for \~306K rows (10.3%) | Some SKUs lack HSN mapping | Use `hsn_generated` or `product_hsn_code` as fallback |
1317: | `awb_num` and `shipping_provider` NULL | AWB not in this table | Use `unicommerce_order_sales_report.other_id` for AWB |
1318: | `total_tcs_amount = 0` for all | Astrotalk is the e-commerce operator; TCS handled elsewhere | No TCS reconciliation in this table |
1319: | `brand` mostly NULL | Brand is implicit in `sales_channel` and `source_gst_name` | Use `sales_channel` / `source_gst_name` for brand grouping |
1320: | Multiple rows per order | Multi-item orders: one row per SKU per order | Use `COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)` for orders, `SUM(charged_amount)` for value |
1321: | `voucher_type_name` = NULL for all | Not populated from Unicommerce integration | Use `metadata` as the authoritative transaction type |
1322: | `return_type` = NULL for some reverse | Use `transaction_type` column instead |            |
1323:

1327: ## 7. Common Query Patterns
1328: 
1329: ### 7.1 GMV by Transaction Type and Month
1330: 
1331: ```sql
1332: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month,
1333:   metadata AS txn_type, transaction_type,
1334:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
1335:   SUM(charged_amount) AS value
1336: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
1337: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211
1338: GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2;
1339: ```
1340: 
1341: ### 7.2 Sales by Channel
1342: 
1343: ```sql
1344: SELECT sales_channel,
1345:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
1346:   SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
1347:   AVG(charged_amount) AS aov,
1348:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(transaction_type='COD') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cod_pct
1349: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
1350: WHERE is_active = true AND metadata = 'sales' AND group_level_id = 211
1351: GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY gmv DESC;
1352: ```
1353: 
1354: ### 7.3 Return Rate (from this table)
1355: 
1356: ```sql
1357: SELECT
1358:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN order_id END) AS sold,
1359:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Courier Return' THEN order_id END) AS rto,
1360:   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' AND transaction_type='Customer Return' THEN order_id END) AS cust_return,
1361:   ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='reverse' THEN order_id END)
1362:     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN metadata='sales' THEN order_id END), 0), 2) AS total_return_rate_pct
1363: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
1364: WHERE is_active = true AND group_level_id = 211;
1365: ```
1366: 
1367: ### 7.4 Join to OSR for AWB and Delivery Status
1368: 
1369: ```sql
1370: SELECT u.order_id, u.invoice_number, u.sku_id, u.description,
1371:   u.metadata, u.transaction_type, u.charged_amount,
1372:   u.destination_state, u.sales_channel,
1373:   o.order_status, o.other_id AS awb, o.shipping_method, o.mrp
1374: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce u
1375: LEFT JOIN zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report o
1376:   ON '#' || u.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true
1377: WHERE u.is_active = true AND u.metadata = 'sales' AND u.group_level_id = 211;
1378: ```
1379: 
1380: ### 7.5 GST Analysis
1381: 
1382: ```sql
1383: SELECT
1384:   CASE WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Interstate' ELSE 'Intrastate' END AS gst_type,
1385:   COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
1386:   SUM(tax_igst_amount) AS igst,
1387:   SUM(tax_cgst_amount + tax_sgst_amount) AS cgst_sgst
1388: FROM zs_observe.unicommerce
1389: WHERE is_active = true AND metadata = 'sales' AND group_level_id = 211
1390: GROUP BY 1;
1391: ```
~~~
